premise: Bird is sure his song makes the sun come up, until the morning he oversleeps and the sun rises anyway — and everyone was still waiting for his song to start their day.
inspiration: Chanticleer, the rooster who believes his crowing raises the sun (European folk, Chaucer), turned: the song doesn't move the sun, but it starts everyone's day — and ends Owl's night.
lesson: What you give matters even when it isn't what you thought.

en-US.title: Bird Wakes the Sun
en-US.text: {canvas:night 0.7} [softly] It was nearly morning. Up on a branch, {bird:enter} {bird:go to branches} Bird was quite sure: {bird:face happy} his song woke up the sun. "I sing, and up it comes!" Down in the meadow, {flower:enter} Flower waited, {flower:live close hold} folded up tight. {owl:enter} {owl:go to branches} Owl {sfx:hoot} hooted from his branch. [curious] "Are you sure?" {bird:live nod} "Of course," said Bird. "I'll just rest my eyes…" {bird:face sleeping} And he {bird:live sleep hold} fell fast asleep. {canvas:sunshine 0.8 24s} Up came the sun anyway. {flower:live close resume} Flower opened wide. {rabbit:enter} Rabbit came hopping out… and stopped. {rabbit:face sad} "Where's the song? I can't start my day without it!" {owl:face sad} [sighs] "And I can't go to sleep without it," said Owl. {bird:live sleep resume} {bird:face surprised} [gasps] Bird woke with a jump. The sun was up without him! {bird:face sad} [sad] "Then what is my song for?" {rabbit:hop x2} "For US!" said Rabbit. {bird:face happy} So Bird {bird:live sing} puffed up his chest and {sfx:birdsong} sang. {rabbit:face happy} {rabbit:hop x3} Off bounced Rabbit to play. {flower:glow} Flower smiled at the sun. {owl:face sleeping} {owl:live doze hold} And Owl, at last, fell fast asleep. [happily] Good morning, meadow. Goodnight, Owl.

es-ES.title: El pájaro que despertaba al sol
es-ES.text: {canvas:night 0.7} [softly] Estaba a punto de amanecer. En una rama, {bird:enter} {bird:go to branches} Pájaro lo tenía clarísimo: {bird:face happy} su canción despertaba al sol. —¡Yo canto, y el sol sale! Abajo, {flower:enter} Flor esperaba {flower:live close hold} bien cerradita. {owl:enter} {owl:go to branches} Búho {sfx:hoot} ululó desde su rama. [curious] —¿Tú crees? {bird:live nod} —Segurísimo —dijo Pájaro—. Voy a cerrar los ojos un momentito… {bird:face sleeping} Y {bird:live sleep hold} se quedó dormido como un tronco. {canvas:sunshine 0.8 24s} Pero el sol salió igual. {flower:live close resume} Flor se abrió de par en par. {rabbit:enter} Conejo salió dando brincos… y se paró en seco. {rabbit:face sad} —¿Y la canción? ¡Sin canción no puedo empezar el día! {owl:face sad} [sighs] —Y yo sin ella no me puedo dormir —dijo Búho. {bird:live sleep resume} {bird:face surprised} [gasps] Pájaro se despertó de un salto. ¡El sol había salido sin él! {bird:face sad} [sad] —Entonces, ¿para qué sirve mi canción? {rabbit:hop x2} —¡Para NOSOTROS! —dijo Conejo. {bird:face happy} Así que Pájaro {bird:live sing} infló el pecho y {sfx:birdsong} cantó. {rabbit:face happy} {rabbit:hop x3} Conejo se fue a jugar dando botes. {flower:glow} Flor le sonrió al sol. {owl:face sleeping} {owl:live doze hold} Y Búho, por fin, se quedó dormido. [happily] Buenos días, prado. Buenas noches, Búho.

ja-JP.title: ことりが おひさまを おこす？
ja-JP.text: {canvas:night 0.7}[softly]もうすぐ朝です。えだの上で、{bird:enter}{bird:go to branches}ことりは、じしんまんまん。{bird:face happy}おひさまをおこすのは、ぼくの歌なんだ。「ぼくがうたえば、のぼってくるのさ！」 下では、{flower:enter}お花が{flower:live close hold}きゅっととじて、まっています。{owl:enter}{owl:go to branches}フクロウくんが、えだから{sfx:hoot}ホーホー。[curious]「ほんとうかい？」 {bird:live nod}「もちろん」 とことり。「ちょっとだけ、目をつぶって…」 {bird:face sleeping}そのまま{bird:live sleep hold}ぐっすり。{canvas:sunshine 0.8 24s}それでも、おひさまはのぼります。{flower:live close resume}お花が、ぱあっとひらきます。{rabbit:enter}ウサギくんが、ぴょんととび出して…ぴたり。{rabbit:face sad}「歌は？歌がないと、一日がはじまらないよ！」 {owl:face sad}[sighs]「ぼくも、ねむれないよ」 とフクロウくん。{bird:live sleep resume}{bird:face surprised}[gasps]ことりは、とびおきました。おひさまが、もうのぼってる！{bird:face sad}[sad]「じゃあ、ぼくの歌は、なんのため？」 {rabbit:hop x2}「ぼくたちのため！」 とウサギくん。{bird:face happy}ことりは{bird:live sing}むねをふくらませて、{sfx:birdsong}うたいました。{rabbit:face happy}{rabbit:hop x3}ウサギくんは、あそびにぴょーん。{flower:glow}お花は、おひさまににっこり。{owl:face sleeping}{owl:live doze hold}フクロウくんは、やっと、ぐっすり。[happily]おはよう、はらっぱ。おやすみ、フクロウくん。

de-DE.title: Der Vogel weckt die Sonne
de-DE.text: {canvas:night 0.7} [softly] Es war fast Morgen. Oben auf einem Ast saß {bird:enter} {bird:go to branches} der Vogel und war sich ganz sicher: {bird:face happy} Sein Lied weckte die Sonne. „Ich singe, und schon geht sie auf!“ Unten wartete {flower:enter} die Blume, {flower:live close hold} fest zusammengefaltet. {owl:enter} {owl:go to branches} Die Eule {sfx:hoot} rief von ihrem Ast: [curious] „Bist du sicher?“ {bird:live nod} „Na klar“, sagte der Vogel. „Ich mach nur kurz die Augen zu…“ {bird:face sleeping} Und schon {bird:live sleep hold} schlief er fest. {canvas:sunshine 0.8 24s} Die Sonne ging trotzdem auf. {flower:live close resume} Die Blume öffnete sich weit. {rabbit:enter} Der Hase kam herausgehoppelt… und blieb stehen. {rabbit:face sad} „Wo bleibt das Lied? Ohne Lied kann mein Tag nicht anfangen!“ {owl:face sad} [sighs] „Und ich schlafe ohne Lied nicht ein“, sagte die Eule. {bird:live sleep resume} {bird:face surprised} [gasps] Der Vogel fuhr hoch. Die Sonne war ohne ihn aufgegangen! {bird:face sad} [sad] „Wofür singe ich dann?“ {rabbit:hop x2} „Für UNS!“, rief der Hase. {bird:face happy} Da {bird:live sing} plusterte der Vogel sich auf und {sfx:birdsong} sang. {rabbit:face happy} {rabbit:hop x3} Der Hase hoppelte los zum Spielen. {flower:glow} Die Blume lächelte die Sonne an. {owl:face sleeping} {owl:live doze hold} Und die Eule schlief endlich ein. [happily] Guten Morgen, Wiese. Gute Nacht, Eule.

fr-FR.title: Oiseau réveille le soleil
fr-FR.text: {canvas:night 0.7} [softly] C’était presque le matin. Sur une branche, {bird:enter} {bird:go to branches} Oiseau en était sûr : {bird:face happy} sa chanson réveillait le soleil. « Je chante, et il se lève ! » En bas, {flower:enter} Fleur attendait, {flower:live close hold} toute fermée. {owl:enter} {owl:go to branches} Hibou a {sfx:hoot} hululé depuis sa branche. [curious] « Tu en es sûr ? » {bird:live nod} « Bien sûr ! Je ferme juste les yeux une minute… » {bird:face sleeping} Et {bird:live sleep hold} aussitôt, il s’est endormi. {canvas:sunshine 0.8 24s} Le soleil s’est levé quand même. {flower:live close resume} Fleur s’est ouverte en grand. {rabbit:enter} Lapin est sorti en sautillant… et s’est arrêté net. {rabbit:face sad} « Et la chanson ? Sans elle, ma journée ne peut pas commencer ! » {owl:face sad} [sighs] « Et moi, sans elle, je ne peux pas dormir », a dit Hibou. {bird:live sleep resume} {bird:face surprised} [gasps] Oiseau s’est réveillé en sursaut. Le soleil s’était levé sans lui ! {bird:face sad} [sad] « Alors, à quoi sert ma chanson ? » {rabbit:hop x2} « À NOUS ! » a dit Lapin. {bird:face happy} Alors Oiseau {bird:live sing} a bombé le torse et {sfx:birdsong} il a chanté. {rabbit:face happy} {rabbit:hop x3} Lapin est parti jouer en bondissant. {flower:glow} Fleur a souri au soleil. {owl:face sleeping} {owl:live doze hold} Et Hibou, enfin, s’est endormi. [happily] Bonjour, le pré. Bonne nuit, Hibou.

it-IT.title: Uccellino sveglia il sole
it-IT.text: {canvas:night 0.7} [softly] Era quasi mattina. Su un ramo, {bird:enter} {bird:go to branches} Uccellino ne era proprio sicuro: {bird:face happy} era il suo canto a svegliare il sole. «Io canto, e spunta il sole!» Giù nel prato, {flower:enter} Fiore aspettava, {flower:live close hold} chiuso stretto stretto. {owl:enter} {owl:go to branches} Gufo {sfx:hoot} ha fatto uuh, uuh dal suo ramo. [curious] «Ne sei sicuro?» {bird:live nod} «Certo», ha detto Uccellino. «Adesso riposo un attimo gli occhi…» {bird:face sleeping} E {bird:live sleep hold} si è addormentato come un sasso. {canvas:sunshine 0.8 24s} Ma il sole è sorto lo stesso. {flower:live close resume} Fiore si è aperto tutto. {rabbit:enter} Coniglio è uscito saltellando… e si è fermato. {rabbit:face sad} «Dov'è la canzone? Senza canzone non posso cominciare la giornata!» {owl:face sad} [sighs] «E io senza non riesco ad addormentarmi», ha detto Gufo. {bird:live sleep resume} {bird:face surprised} [gasps] Uccellino si è svegliato con un salto. Il sole era sorto senza di lui! {bird:face sad} [sad] «Allora a cosa serve il mio canto?» {rabbit:hop x2} «A NOI!» ha detto Coniglio. {bird:face happy} Così Uccellino {bird:live sing} ha gonfiato il petto e {sfx:birdsong} ha cantato. {rabbit:face happy} {rabbit:hop x3} Coniglio è corso via a giocare, saltellando. {flower:glow} Fiore ha sorriso al sole. {owl:face sleeping} {owl:live doze hold} E Gufo, finalmente, si è addormentato. [happily] Buongiorno, prato. Buonanotte, Gufo.

zh-TW.title: 小鳥叫醒太陽
zh-TW.text: {canvas:night 0.7}[softly]天快亮了。高高的樹枝上，{bird:enter}{bird:go to branches}小鳥非常確定：{bird:face happy}是牠的歌把太陽叫醒的。「我一唱歌，太陽就起床！」 草地上，{flower:enter}小花靜靜等著，{flower:live close hold}花瓣合得緊緊的。{owl:enter}{owl:go to branches}貓頭鷹在牠的樹枝上{sfx:hoot}咕咕叫。[curious]「你確定嗎？」 {bird:live nod}「當然囉。」 小鳥說，「我先閉一下眼睛就好……」 {bird:face sleeping}結果，牠{bird:live sleep hold}呼呼大睡了。{canvas:sunshine 0.8 24s}太陽還是照樣升起來了。{flower:live close resume}小花張開了花瓣。{rabbit:enter}兔子蹦蹦跳跳地跑出來……又停住了。{rabbit:face sad}「歌呢？沒有歌，我的一天要怎麼開始？」 {owl:face sad}[sighs]「沒有歌，我也睡不著呀。」 貓頭鷹說。{bird:live sleep resume}{bird:face surprised}[gasps]小鳥一下子跳了起來。太陽自己出來了，沒有等牠！{bird:face sad}[sad]「那……我的歌是唱來做什麼的？」 {rabbit:hop x2}「唱給我們聽的呀！」 兔子說。{bird:face happy}於是小鳥{bird:live sing}挺起胸膛，{sfx:birdsong}唱起歌來。{rabbit:face happy}{rabbit:hop x3}兔子蹦蹦跳跳地玩去了。{flower:glow}小花對著太陽微笑。{owl:face sleeping}{owl:live doze hold}貓頭鷹呢，終於睡著了。[happily]草地，早安。貓頭鷹，晚安。

zh-HK.title: 小鳥叫太陽起身
zh-HK.text: {canvas:night 0.7}[softly]天快亮了。高高的樹枝上，{bird:enter}{bird:go to branches}小鳥十分肯定：{bird:face happy}太陽是被牠的歌叫醒的。「我一唱歌，太陽就起身！」 草地上，{flower:enter}小花靜靜地等着，{flower:live close hold}花瓣合得緊緊的。{owl:enter}{owl:go to branches}貓頭鷹在牠的樹枝上{sfx:hoot}咕咕叫。[curious]「你肯定？」 {bird:live nod}「梗係啦。」 小鳥說，「我瞇一陣眼先……」 {bird:face sleeping}結果，牠{bird:live sleep hold}呼呼大睡了。{canvas:sunshine 0.8 24s}可是，太陽照樣升起來了。{flower:live close resume}小花張開了花瓣。{rabbit:enter}兔子一蹦一跳地跑出來……忽然停住了。{rabbit:face sad}「首歌呢？冇咗首歌，我點開始新嘅一日呀？」 {owl:face sad}[sighs]「冇咗首歌，我都瞓唔着呀。」 貓頭鷹說。{bird:live sleep resume}{bird:face surprised}[gasps]小鳥一下子跳了起來。太陽自己升起來了，沒有等牠！{bird:face sad}[sad]「咁……我首歌唱嚟做乜㗎？」 {rabbit:hop x2}「唱畀我哋聽㗎！」 兔子說。{bird:face happy}於是小鳥{bird:live sing}挺起胸膛，{sfx:birdsong}唱起歌來。{rabbit:face happy}{rabbit:hop x3}兔子一蹦一跳地玩去了。{flower:glow}小花對着太陽微笑。{owl:face sleeping}{owl:live doze hold}而貓頭鷹，終於睡着了。[happily]早晨，草地！早唞，貓頭鷹。
